svg.text: Implemented entities and exact attributes - PostgreSQL migrations 010-060 + Mongo telemetry
Rectangles: entities | Ellipses: attributes | Diamonds: relationships | Underline: primary key | Dashed ellipse: stored generated column
1 = exactly one; 0..1 = optional one; 0..N = zero or many. Brown dashed links are application-validated Mongo references, not SQL foreign keys.
Mongo payload.ip_routing_hash / connection_type / latency_ms / tls_cipher / vpn_detected belong to connection_telemetry; the other payload fields belong to client_environment.
candidate_session_ids is a retained UUID-array snapshot, not an FK. View/tooling blocks are distinguished from the 17 application tables. Source: main 843f0af95974 | 30 October 2026
